interaction_phrase: became the first bank to join BT
occurrence_sentence: In July, HSBC became the first bank to join BT and Toshiba's quantum secure metro network, working in collaboration with AWS – installing quantum infrastructure in their Global Headquarters in Canary Wharf that spans 63km via fibre-optic cables to their data centre in Slough.
